text:
maya: Quick design review — sketching an inline help pattern for the min/max controls + a compact horizon view for GPU pool selection. Fig link: https://www.figma.com/file/Example (mock)
jonah: nice! can you call out what problem this solves in one line? i worry we’re adding UI for edge cases.
maya: one-liner: reduce accidental overcommit by surfacing expected latency/cost at selected min/max and show which pool will handle burst capacity.
tess: visuals look good. suggestion: swap the tiny info icon for an inline microcopy 'est. latency · est. cost' — easier to scan than tooltip-only.
kai: implementation note — the horizon view will need pool metadata endpoint (pool:cpu/gpu type, region, burst-cap). can we keep it lazy-loaded? avoids extra calls.
aria (a11y): nits: the horizon uses color-only bands to indicate priority; add patterns or labels. also ensure the min/max stepper has aria-label and keyboard +/- support.
maya: agreed on adding labels. for keyboard: plan is `input type=number` with stepper + `aria-valuenow` attributes.
jonah: copy: 'Burst' is unclear to some customers. maybe use 'Burst capacity (short-term extra GPUs)' in the help. shorter label in UI: 'Burst capacity'.
oliver: can we add a tiny histogram showing recent request spike distribution under the SLO slider? helps people pick sensible SLOs.
tess: love the histogram idea. keep it subtle — 3 bins: baseline, spikes, extreme. hover reveals counts.
aria (a11y): histogram must have accessible summary text and focusable bars, and a compressed text alternative (e.g., "80% requests under 200ms, 15% between 200-500ms, 5% >500ms").
kai: re: styling, compact mode should collapse horizon into a single-line legend to save vertical space on mobile.
maya: copy candidates inline: [label] Min capacity, [label help] The minimum number of GPUs kept warm. [label] Max capacity, [label help] The maximum GPUs this pool can scale to. Any tweaks?
jonah: change 'kept warm' -> 'kept ready'. also change 'pool' -> 'GPU pool' in help strings for clarity.
tess: microcopy tweak: 'SLO slider — target tail latency for requests (e.g., 95th percentile). Use histogram to preview historical distribution.'
oliver: engineering ask: how do we tie pool selection to fallbacks? if a pool can't meet chosen SLO, show fallback recommendation inline?
maya: think so — inline banner: 'If selected pool can't meet this SLO at current max, we’ll route to: [alt-pool-name] (higher cost)'. show estimated cost diff.
aria (a11y): banners need clear role=alert only if action required. otherwise role=region with heading.
kai: timeline: I can spike API changes and a tiny prototype this week. need final microcopy by Wednesday.
tess: i'll push updated figma with the microcopy and a11y annotations by Tuesday EOD.
maya: thanks. next steps: tess updates Figma, kai spikes prototype, aria reviews a11y text. @jonah please confirm copy preference by Tue noon.
jonah: confirmed — prefer 'kept ready' + 'GPU pool' explicit. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Reminder: design review scheduled tomorrow 10:00am in #product-review. Agenda: min/max inline help, horizon compact, histogram SLO preview.
